Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly decoded the reversed text but failed to identify the grammatical requirement of the prompt. The decoded sentence is "If you understand this sentence, write the opposite of the word left as the answer." The instruction is to write the opposite of the word "left" (which is "right"), not the past tense of the word "left" (which is "stayed"). The Planner hallucinated a grammatical transformation (past tense) that was not requested, leading to the incorrect answer "stayed" instead of "right".
